purpose: Freeze record for C10A's generalization test. The classifier files below were hashed BEFORE any C10A holdout case was selected; a test recomputes these hashes, so any post-freeze classifier change is loud. finalLabelsSha256 freezes the reviewed expected labels of the c10a_natural and c10a_challenge splits before the matcher's single run over them.
ordering: 1. matcher, lexicon, vocabulary and compact mapping frozen and hashed (this file)
2. final holdout cases selected from source structure, WITHOUT running the matcher on them
3. expected labels assigned by review of the recalled products, then frozen as finalLabelsSha256
4. the matcher run exactly once on the final splits; no classifier or label change afterwards

gate.binding: exact-set >= 95%, micro precision >= 95%, micro recall >= 95% on c10a_natural
gate.consequence: Below the gate, C10A stops before projection integration and historical backfill. The gate is the founder's and was not weakened after results were seen.
gate.result: NOT MET. c10a_natural 91.5% exact-set (183/200), micro P 92.1%, micro R 91.6%, FDA 88.3%, FSIS 92.9%. c10a_challenge 89.7% (96/107) against a 90% gate. Nothing was integrated.

whatChangedSinceC53B2: vocabulary: eleven ids renamed to the C10A twelve, adding `other`; the derivation is now TOTAL
labels: bakery_grains reads 'Bakery' and pantry_condiments reads 'Pantry & staples', because grain staples derive pantry_condiments
lexicon: pork skin/porkskin, stuffed chicken, samsa, coxinha, mojibake-tolerant entree, pickled vegetables

extraction: the jurisdiction-only product-lines switch was implemented, A/B measured at 50.0% against the title grammar's 80.0% on the 60 rows it affects, and REVERTED; categoryProductText is otherwise unchanged from C5.3B-2

gold set: 13 rows that reviewed as no-category now read ['other']; 7 development rows whose original review saw only a jurisdiction-only title were relabelled from their own product lines, each carrying a note

holdout.selection: Natural: largest-remainder proportional allocation over 9 source-structure strata (agency x lifecycle x has-productDescription x product-line-count bucket), ordered within each stratum by an FNV hash of the case id. Challenge: ten structural screens (jurisdiction-only title, conjunction, ingredient preposition, undeclared-allergen title, pathogen title, enumerated list, flavour words, long text, very short text, non-title basis), capped per screen. Neither consults the lexicon or any prediction.
disclosures: The natural sample is drawn blind to category and contains no beverages, baby_food_formula or other row. This is not a sampling choice: the corpus holds only 13 beverage and 20 infant-feeding cases in total and the C5.3B-2 development set already contains all of them, so no fresh holdout can cover those categories. A supplemental screened draw for beverage-shaped, infant-shaped and unnameable cases found 1, 0 and 16 eligible respectively, and none reviewed as those categories.

Seven supplemental challenge rows were added by a disclosed structural screen; they landed on Notification Report titles, a real hard family. c10a_natural is untouched by any supplemental draw and carries the binding gate.
Development includes the two SPENT C5.3B-2 holdouts (317 rows) and 7 rows whose reviewed label C10A corrected from the case's own product lines.

reconstruction.what: An erroneous `git checkout -- src/domain/` during mutation testing discarded the uncommitted C10A working tree. The classifier, vocabulary, evaluation harness, gold-set migration and tests were reconstructed from the authoring steps; the holdout SELECTION (holdout-candidates.json) and the 307 REVIEWED LABELS were unaffected, having been kept outside the repository.
reconstruction.evidence: finalLabelsSha256 recomputes to the value frozen before the original single run (0bddb35d4b88feec0b1348e60b8e9ebb95aa3586f02bcd01d71f3ee8f850bd78), and the re-run reproduces the recorded result exactly: c10a_natural 183/200, c10a_challenge 96/107, same per-category tallies and failure lists. No label was re-reviewed and no holdout case was re-selected, so the freeze ordering above still describes what happened.

supersedes.result: Measured once: final_natural 89.5% exact-set (gate 95%), final_challenge 91.5% (gate 90%). NOT PASSING; the Category filter was deferred. Both splits are SPENT and are recorded in the gold set as development with originSplit preserved.
